name: AniSkip
summary: Intro and ending timestamps, so the player can offer a skip button.
description: Supplies opening and ending intervals for an episode from the community AniSkip database, which the player turns into a skip button and the auto-skip setting. Needs a MyAnimeList id on the episode; titles without one simply get no skip data. This is the same source the client used to call directly — as an extension it can be turned off, replaced, and its failures show up in the developer portal like any other.

types.description: Which intervals to fetch: opening and ending, or only one of them.

min_length.description: Ignore intervals shorter than this many seconds. Very short ones are usually bad submissions and produce a skip button that jumps nowhere.
